note: One dose of the rubella vaccine offers effective protection (≥95%) against rubella. In practice, many children receive it as part of the MMR (measles, mumps, rubella) vaccine, which required two doses in total.
title: Share of one-year-olds vaccinated against rubella
subtitle: Share of one-year-olds who received at least one dose of the rubella vaccine. Rubella is a contagious viral infection that occurs most often in children and young adults. A rubella infection in pregnant women may cause fetal death or congenital defects known as congenital rubella syndrome.
